Based on the visual evidence in the provided image:

(1) **Yes**, the action bar row containing the 'حذف المحدد' (Delete Selected) and 'نوع الصف' (Page Type) buttons is partially cut off and covered at its bottom edge by the bottom navigation bar.

(2) **Approximately 10 to 15 pixels** of the button/action bar appear to be clipped or hidden behind the navigation bar.

(3) **No**, the action bar is not clearly visible as a separate, complete element; it is obscured by the navigation bar, making the bottom portion of the buttons (and potentially any padding) invisible.
